_doc: CA charter school muni obligor universe — v2 (audit-corrected against primary sources)
_methodology_v2: v2 was produced by hard re-verification of every v1 obligor against (a) ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer for EIN + Form 990 financials, (b) CDE School Directory pages for school open/closed status, (c) CSFA conduit issuance records / press releases for bond structure, and (d) the Charter Validation Pass document. v1 carried at least 3 false school-closure claims (View Park Prep Middle, Aveson School of Leaders, Aveson Global Leadership Academy) and 8+ wrong EINs. v2 fixes every fact for which a primary source was retrievable in this pass and marks every other field UNVERIFIABLE rather than carrying a guess. Honest discipline: where the v1 source url said 'EMMA' but EMMA returned 403 in agent context, the par_usd field stays UNVERIFIABLE.
_v2_caveats: (1) EMMA was gated to WebFetch in this audit (consistent with prior session experience). Outstanding par amounts that cannot be confirmed via press release / CSFA notice / SEC NPORT-P remain UNVERIFIABLE. (2) Several v1 par amounts that survived as numeric values appear to be guessed — e.g., Aspire 2020A 'par_usd: 75000000' vs verified $33.3M + $5M taxable Issue No. 3; Granada Hills 2021 '$38M' vs verified $13.6M Series 2021A&B. The audit treats every v1 par_usd value as untrusted until cross-verified. (3) Structure classification (csfa_intercept / cscda_no_intercept / pcsd_lease / private_placement / unknown_or_no_bonds) is the primary v2 deliverable for the upcoming CSFA LCFF intercept spread test.

_structure_class_definitions.csfa_intercept: CSFA-issued conduit bonds with State Controller LCFF intercept under Ed Code 17199.4. Per masking_mechanisms.json csfa_lcff_intercept entry, this is the 'partial-masking 2-3 notch enhancement' category that trades to ~90-145 bps over MMD AAA for BBB-rated names. Operator signal still partially visible in spread.
_structure_class_definitions.cscda_no_intercept: California Statewide Communities Development Authority (CSCDA) — conduit issuer used by some Bay Area charters. No LCFF intercept mechanism; trades to operator credit. Wider spreads.
_structure_class_definitions.cmfa_intercept_or_other: California Municipal Finance Authority (CMFA) conduit. Structure varies by deal; verify per-CUSIP.
_structure_class_definitions.calpfa_other: California Public Finance Authority (CalPFA) conduit. Verify per-CUSIP.
_structure_class_definitions.pcsd_lease: Pacific Charter School Development facility-lease structure. Bonds backed by multi-charter PCSD lease portfolio, NOT direct obligor credit. Per masking_mechanisms.json pcsd_facility_credit entry, single-charter operator signal is masked.
_structure_class_definitions.ccsa_jpa_pool: California Charter Schools Association Joint Powers Authority pooled financing. Single-obligor signal masked at pool level.
_structure_class_definitions.private_placement: Bank-purchased / private placement debt. No SEC continuing-disclosure obligations, no EMMA material event filings. Per masking_mechanisms.json charter_private_placement_opacity entry — operator distress invisible at bond level.
_structure_class_definitions.unknown_or_no_bonds: Operator does not have outstanding muni debt at obligor level (privately funded, no muni issuance, or universe-entry error from v1).
